description: This file implements the logic for generating a Balance Sheet report within the ERPNext accounting module. It includes functions for collecting financial data, calculating provisional profit/loss, checking opening balances, and preparing chart data for visualization.

methods.name: execute(filters=None)
methods.description: Main function to generate the balance sheet report, returning columns, data, messages, chart, and summary.

methods.name: get_provisional_profit_loss(asset, liability, equity, period_list, company, currency=None, consolidated=False)
methods.description: Calculates provisional profit and loss by comparing asset, liability, and equity data across periods.

methods.name: check_opening_balance(asset, liability, equity)
methods.description: Checks if the previous year's balance sheet was closed by examining opening balances.

methods.name: get_report_summary(period_list, asset, liability, equity, provisional_profit_loss, total_credit, currency, filters, consolidated=False)
methods.description: Aggregates and summarizes total asset, liability, equity, and provisional profit/loss across periods.

methods.name: get_chart_data(filters, columns, asset, liability, equity)
methods.description: Prepares chart data with labels and datasets for visualizing the balance sheet.
